test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The ratio of the radius of Hemisphere A to Hemisphere B is 2 : 1.

If the curved surface area of Hemisphere A is equal to the volume of Hemisphere B, find the radius of Hemisphere B.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of radii rA : rB = 2 : 1 ⇒ rA = 2rB

Given: CSA of A = Volume of B

2 × π × (2rB)² = (2/3) × π × (rB)³

8 × π × rB² = (2/3) × π × rB³

8 = (2/3) × rB ⇒ rB = (8 × 3) ÷ 2 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radii rA : rB = 2 : 1

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere A = Volume of Hemisphere B

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2πr²

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b87ffece4cc6628308ba8ada7beb932e814f5b73c3b56404790aabeafa3626d.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of Hemisphere B be x cm.

⇒ Radius of Hemisphere A = 2x cm

⇒ CSA of Hemisphere A = 2 × π × (2x)²

⇒ CSA of Hemisphere A = 2 × π × 4x² = 8πx²

⇒ Volume of Hemisphere B = (2/3) × π × x³

According to the question:

⇒ 8πx² = (2/3)πx³

Cancelling π and x² from both sides:

⇒ 8 = (2/3)x

⇒ x = (8 × 3) ÷ 2

⇒ x = 24 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the flat circular base: TSA = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr².

Properties of a Sphere

A sphere is a perfectly round geometrical object. Its Volume = (4/3)πr³ and Surface Area = 4πr².

Ratio of Volumes

If the ratio of radii of two similar solids is a : b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a² : b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³ : b³.</p
